title: Well-Dressed Man in Citrus Grove, 1940s Florida B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of an older, gray-haired man wearing spectacles, a formal wool suit jacket and trousers, and light-colored shoes, standing in a sunny citrus grove. He leans slightly forward, holding or inspecting an orange growing on a tree laden with fruit. The ground beneath him is sandy and dotted with fallen citrus, characteristic of Florida or Southern California orchards from the mid-20th century.
